acceptanceCriteria: The provider row reason names the failing file relative to the repository root, never an absolute path or the user's home directory, and the same repository yields the same reason text on two machines; a test covers a `file:///` error message.
body:
Filed on 2026-09-23 from the independent reviews of the V1 wave-3 pull requests. Review of PR #98 (V1-0099): the reason text 'gopls answered all N queries with an error; first: <error>' copies the JSON-RPC error message as-is, and gopls's message contains the absolute file URI, e.g. `file:///private/tmp/.../healthchecks.go`. A repository under a home folder would put the user's home path into the packet, and the text differs between machines (TCP-V0-045).

Progress 2026-09-29: draft PR #361 head 0d18ffa6 repairs a reproduced leak of an unrelated file:///Users URI and synthetic token from a fake gopls error. The failure reason now uses only method, admitted repository-relative origin and a fixed class; foreign serverInfo.name is also withheld. The adversarial test failed before and passed after, a two-root local stability test passed, focused provider/external/CLI/spec checks and independent review passed, and dogfood CEM change/check/seal passed with 8 supported hunks and 0 unknown. OCM links are 0/80. Cross-host CI, the ticket-required full gate, merge/integration and native completion write remain pending; keep OPEN.


2026-09-29 CI update: draft PR #361 head 0d18ffa68c21b260e7824e5a151547ece5c22be8 passed artifact-integrity, doc-gates, docs-plan, go-interop, all four go-product shards, and the go-product aggregate. Independent final diff review remained clear. Ticket stays OPEN for integration and required full-gate; no merge has been authorized for this PR.
